blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Team Philippines officially closes its campaign in the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Sunday, October 4. One event remains to be contested—the individual jumping event in equestrian—before the delegations prepare for the closing ceremony and the Games’ conclusion. Team Philippines schedule for October 4, Sunday at Aichi Nagoya Asian Games 2026 8:30am – Equestrian – Jumping, individual A (heights of 1.40-1.50m) – Colin Syquia (horse: Hocus Pocus) – FINAL second round 5pm – Closing ceremonies at Paloma Mizuho Stadium.
